name: Silver Whetstone
lore: Old-kingdom grit in a silver case. The edge chooses what it becomes.

name: Might Whetstone
lore: Coarse stone from the border quarries. The edge it leaves wants using.

name: Crit Whetstone
lore: Fine-grained and patient. The edge it leaves finds seams by itself.

name: Hit Whetstone
lore: It trues the blade's line. Steadier steel, steadier hands.

name: Weight Whetstone
lore: It takes off metal the smith swore was necessary. It was not.
